reviews.review_msg: If you take a reacting to the past course with Diana be prepared to read and use what you read in class every day. Missing class is not optional as you will fall behind. However, this is an amazing class, the way she teaches made me enjoy Shakespeare for the first time ever. It is a lot of work but if you put in the work you will genuinely have fun

She was very caring to all the students in the class while also being very passionate about this course subject. The material was pretty dry and it felt like a history course, but she made the class fun for us. A lot of reading expected for every week.
